description: CNQ v2.0.0 standard self-test corpus. Frozen reference inputs covering the full diagnostic surface: D=8 twin-quaternion native (load-bearing), D=16 quad-quaternion (schema-locked, v2.1 implementation), pairwise coverage, period-2 / period-4 alternation, coupled vs decoupled stereo, monotonic drift, crossover misalignment, and edge cases. See STANDARD_TEST_MATRICES.md for human-readable per-test descriptions.

matrices.description: All carriers equal at every step. Centroid case: Hs near 0, ring class Hs-1, kappa_HS singular off the simplex interior. Exercises closure, CLR=0, ILR=0, attractor near fixed-point, helmsman flips=0.
Carrier 0 dominant at constant 10x baseline. Hs near 1, ring class Hs-6. Exercises the high-Higgins-scale path; helmsman should consistently flag carrier 0.

Two-state alternation between [3,1,1,1,1,1,1,1] and [1,3,1,1,1,1,1,1]. Period-2 limit cycle in 1-D ILR axis. Attractor fitter should detect period=2 with stability > 0.9; helmsman.chaos_indicator should detect period-doubling depth 1.

Random Dirichlet-distributed compositions with concentration alpha=1.0 (uniform on simplex). Frozen seed for reproducibility. Exercises typical-case throughput and statistical robustness; expect helmsman.flips count in a known range, no period structure detected.

D=8 split as factor_A = axes [0,1,2] and factor_B = axes [3,4,5] in ILR space, where the underlying compositional changes drive both halves through a shared rotation. Twin-quaternion factoring should give small rho_AB (tightly coupled). CHSH S-value expected high.
D=8 same partition as stereo_coupled but factors A and B driven by independent rotations. Twin-quaternion factoring should give large rho_AB (decoupled). CHSH S-value expected low.
Smooth monotonic trend, no period structure. Carrier 0 grows, carrier D-1 shrinks, others slowly drift. Attractor fitter should NOT fit period-2 (fitted=False). Helmsman flips low.

Designed to exercise all C(8,2)=28 pairwise diagnostics. Each pair of carriers shares a known correlation pattern at a different segment of the trajectory; the engine's stage2.carrier_pair_examination should report each pattern in its expected range.
D=16 uniform centroid. Schema-locked test for v2.1 quad-quaternion implementation. Currently exercises only the D>=5 reduced-projection branch (first 3 ILR axes).
D=16 random Dirichlet, T=128, frozen seed. Typical-case stress for the 15-dim ILR space.
Single-row trajectory at D=4. Exercises T=1 graceful-degenerate path: no quaternion sandwich pairs, no attractor fit, schema-consistent null residuals.
Minimum two-row trajectory at D=4. Exactly one quaternion sandwich pair; attractor fit unfit (T < T_min); schema fully populated.
D=2 minimum-carrier trajectory. Tests degenerate_2part_bearing_only path: no quaternion path, bearing_only block populated, schema consistent.
